setup_multiprocess_prometheus: setup prometheus multiprocessing with an auto-created temp directory for vLLM metrics
get_prometheus_registry: get a prometheus CollectorRegistry configured for multiprocess or default mode
unregister_vllm_metrics: unregister all vLLM prometheus collectors from the global registry for testing or CI
shutdown_prometheus: shutdown prometheus metrics and mark the current process as dead for multiprocess cleanup
test_prometheus_multiprocess: test prometheus multiprocess setup, registry retrieval, metric unregistration, and shutdown
